# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.13 — Preview and Smart Drag audit fixes

<!-- update-summary: Preview.13 fixes repository-shaped image Preview/Quick Actions, fail-closed Smart OLE authorization, owner-thread probe cleanup, multi-selection routing, asynchronous hotkey lifecycle, and bounded DropLink replay admission. -->

Preview.13 is a reliability and audit follow-up to Preview.12. It keeps the same Windows 10 version 1809 (Build 17763) and Windows 11 support declaration and the Dynamic-Island-only product boundary.

## Preview and Quick Actions

- Added one shared content resolver for external files and confined app-owned payloads.
- Normal image files that are stored as `ItemKind.File` can now reach Image Preview, image transforms, hash/ZIP actions, export capability, and the Image Quick Action profile.
- App-owned image payloads now resolve to the same Preview/Action content path without mutating the original source.
- ZIP and Hash actions preserve bounded output naming, collision safety, and source immutability while accepting resolved payload-backed files.
- Main-page More actions now pass the full current selection only when the clicked card belongs to that selection; clicking outside the selection stays single-item.

## Smart Drag and native lifecycle

- Smart OLE verification now calls actual acceptance resolution. File-like format evidence alone never reveals the Dynamic Island.
- `CF_HDROP` must resolve to at least one real path; Shell IDList data must resolve before `CanAcceptNow` is set. Virtual files remain materializable only through the real Drop path.
- Completion and cleanup window messages both reach the probe owner-thread handler. Pending results, timers, OLE registration, registry entries, and HWND cleanup are cleared on the owner thread.
- Global Quick Panel hotkey startup and shutdown use bounded asynchronous readiness/exit signals and no UI-thread `Wait`/`Join` lifecycle path.

## DropLink and updater boundary

- DropLink looks up the stored peer secret before reserving replay state. Nonce admission is bounded by length, age, total entries, and entries per known peer; unknown peers do not grow the cache.
- Manual Preview installation remains an explicit user action after integrity verification, including unsigned Preview artifacts. Unattended installation still requires a trusted publisher.
- The App project now treats compiler warnings as errors.

## Validation boundary

- Added Core policy tests for image semantics, Smart visual authorization, and selection routing.
- Added Infrastructure tests for external/payload image resolution and Preview, bounded DropLink nonce replay protection, and manual unsigned Preview installation policy.
- The release workflow remains the source of Windows build, installer, portable EXE, unsigned MSIX, checksum, update-manifest, GitHub Release, and official website/API verification.
- This Preview remains CONDITIONAL until the Windows CI/release run, real Windows OS/DPI/provider/OLE/multi-selection evidence, two-device DropLink evidence, and operator-deployed Worker/browser acceptance are recorded. Hosted Linux checks do not substitute for those rows.

Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview. Select the Preview channel only to test the hardening behavior.
